replay_determinism.method: copied only the two raw .json+.meta.json files into a deleted temp directory outside /mnt/data; ran build_processed_from_raw for each product
replay_determinism.metadata_identical_excluding_fields_note: 'file' differs because the processed filename embeds the publication timestamp, which changes together with created_at_utc on every replay; the original acceptance criterion pre-authorized excluding only created_at_utc, and 'file' was added as a second necessary exclusion at review. No other metadata field differed.

volume_unit.note: These values are also written in the processed metadata as volume_unit_* fields; only the inference is recorded, not a confirmed unit.

rate_limit_headers.note: This only shows that the coinbase-advanced-py 1.7.0 response objects exposed no x-ratelimit-* attributes in this run. It is not evidence about what Coinbase's HTTP response actually contained. Coinbase's public-endpoint rate limits remain unknown.

request_spacing.configured_throttle_note: This is the script's configured minimum spacing (MIN_REQUEST_INTERVAL_S in coinbase_ingest.py), not a measured value.

m5c_input_m5a_overlap_comparison.method: Single comparison, 4 days apart: M5a discovery evidence directory downloads/coinbase/discovery/20261015T141326Z/ (files 05/06/09/10/12/13, fetched 2026-10-15) against this run's raw candles (fetched 2026-10-19), per product. The M5a 2026-10-15 partial day was excluded from both sides.
m5c_input_m5a_overlap_comparison.note: This is one comparison across a 4-day gap, not a general characterization of Coinbase's revision behavior. The general question of historical candle revisions remains open and belongs to M5c.

sanity_facts_not_investigated.note: These are facts only, not gates, and carry no explanation or judgement.

open_questions: Coinbase's actual public-endpoint rate limits remain unknown; the SDK exposed no rate-limit headers in this run, which is a tooling observation, not evidence about the HTTP response.
Candle revision behavior beyond this single, 4-day-apart, zero-difference comparison against M5a is not characterized; pending M5c.
Candle volume_unit remains inferred (base_asset), not confirmed against an authoritative source.
